authority_ruling: Current Glean Docs and the Customer Support SLA (tier 1) win any conflict. Tier 2 internal guidance is used only where tier 1 does not contradict it.
excluded_sources: [External] Glean Support for Customers (2024-10) - predates 2026 support migration
Partner escalation meeting notes (2026-09-25) - not published policy
open_sme_questions: SME-01: Can a partner file a Glean ticket for a customer under the partner's own account, naming the customer in the request?
SME-02: What is the published escalation path after a ticket is filed and stalls?
attribution_notes: SLA response times are presented as Glean's commitment to the customer, never as a partner commitment.
Partner escalation guidance beyond published docs is labelled studio guidance in the module.
